reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Authorization of administrative adjudication systems in eligible cities
headings.reviewNote: Covers municipal authorization for administrative adjudication of civil nonmoving code violations in designated population classes.

headings.title: Designation of administrative tribunal and hearing procedures
headings.reviewNote: Covers ordinance designation of administrative tribunal, subject violations, supervision, and court-approved hearing procedures.

headings.title: Due process standards, evidence rules, and citation prima facie effect
headings.reviewNote: Covers due process guarantees, relaxed evidence rules admitting prudent-person evidence, and citation documentation as prima facie evidence.

headings.title: Imprisonment prohibition, fine limits, and debt collection
headings.reviewNote: Covers prohibition on incarceration, limitation on fines, and collection of unpaid final sanctions as debts due the city.

headings.title: Judicial review, enforcement of orders, and property liens
headings.reviewNote: Covers judicial review under chapter 536 or trial de novo, order enforcement as judgments, and imposition of property liens or special tax bills.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all five subsections on administrative adjudication of civil nonmoving municipal code violations in eligible cities, tribunal procedures, relaxed evidence rules, fine/incarceration limits, and judicial review/liens.

headings.title: Municipal judge selection, minimum two-year tenure, and jurisdiction
headings.reviewNote: Covers municipal authority or duty to provide for municipal judge selection, minimum two-year terms, and ordinance jurisdiction.

headings.title: Part-time service in multiple municipalities
headings.reviewNote: Covers authorization for part-time municipal judges to serve across multiple municipalities unless barred by charter or ordinance.

headings.title: Law license qualifications and grandfathered exemption
headings.reviewNote: Covers requirement of law license for judges in municipalities of 7,500 or first-class charter counties and pre-1979 grandfather exemption.

headings.title: Residency requirements within state
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that municipal judges must reside in Missouri but need not reside in the municipality or circuit unless required by local law.

headings.title: Circuit court division status and presiding judge supervision
headings.reviewNote: Covers status of municipal courts as divisions of the circuit court subject to circuit rules and presiding judge administrative authority.

headings.title: Dual officeholding ban and compensation restrictions
headings.reviewNote: Covers prohibition on municipal judges holding other municipal office and ban on case-volume or fine-dependent compensation.

headings.title: Age qualifications and mandatory retirement age
headings.reviewNote: Covers minimum age of twenty-one and mandatory retirement at age seventy-five for municipal judges.

headings.title: Mandatory course of instruction for nonattorney judges
headings.reviewNote: Covers mandatory six-month completion of supreme court instruction course for nonlawyer judges and forfeiture of office upon noncompliance.

headings.title: Maximum five-municipality service limitation
headings.reviewNote: Covers restriction limiting municipal judges to serving in no more than five municipalities simultaneously.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all nine subsections on municipal judge selection, part-time service, law license/grandfathering, Missouri residency, circuit division status, dual-office/compensation bans, age limits (21–75), nonlawyer instruction, and five-municipality cap.

headings.title: Written notice to circuit clerk before hearing cases
headings.reviewNote: Covers requirement that municipalities under 400,000 notify the circuit clerk in writing before municipal judges hear cases.

headings.title: Transition terms for sitting judges on January 1, 1979
headings.reviewNote: Covers authorization for sitting municipal judges on January 1, 1979, to serve out terms regardless of qualification requirements.

headings.title: Automatic transition and merit retention in large cities
headings.reviewNote: Covers automatic circuit division transition and continuation of merit retention plans for full-time judges in cities over 400,000.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all three subsections on written notice to circuit clerk by municipalities under 400,000, January 1, 1979 sitting judge transition terms, and automatic transition/merit retention in cities over 400,000 (Effective 1-02-79).

headings.title: Municipal election for associate circuit court or specialized docket
headings.reviewNote: Covers municipal election to have ordinance violations or designated special-needs cases heard by associate circuit judges.

headings.title: Six-month commencement period following election notice
headings.reviewNote: Covers six-month delay before associate circuit judges commence hearing municipal cases absent earlier consent of presiding judge.

headings.title: Mandatory associate circuit judge jurisdiction absent municipal judge
headings.reviewNote: Covers mandatory hearing of municipal ordinance violations by associate circuit judges when municipality under 400,000 provides no judge.

headings.title: Contract for county municipal court prosecution
headings.reviewNote: Covers authorization for municipality under 400,000 to contract with county for ordinance prosecution in county municipal court.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all four subsections on municipal election to use associate circuit judges or specialized dockets, six-month transition notice, default associate circuit jurisdiction, and county municipal court contracts.

headings.title: Municipal duty to provide courtroom, clerk, and personnel
headings.reviewNote: Covers municipal obligation to provide courtroom, clerk, and personnel when establishing municipal judge positions.

headings.title: Municipal courtroom provision for associate circuit judge
headings.reviewNote: Covers municipal duty to provide courtroom when requesting associate circuit judge to sit within municipality.

headings.title: Salaries and expenses for local nonjudicial personnel
headings.reviewNote: Covers municipal payment of salaries and expenses for nonjudicial personnel stationed in municipality at municipal request.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all three subsections on municipal obligations to provide courtrooms, clerks, personnel, and expenses for municipal divisions and locally seated associate circuit judges/staff (Effective 1-02-79).

headings.title: Monthly fine and cost deposit into municipal treasury
headings.reviewNote: Covers requirement that fines and costs collected before municipal judge be deposited at least monthly into municipal treasury.

headings.title: Deposit of fines and state court costs before associate judge
headings.reviewNote: Covers monthly deposit of fines into municipal treasury and remittance of costs to state treasury in cases before associate judges.

headings.title: Monthly case accounting lists and transmittal procedures
headings.reviewNote: Covers monthly reporting lists of cases, fines, costs, and de novo applications filed with municipal clerk and governing body.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all three subsections on monthly deposit of fines/costs in municipal or state treasuries and supreme court uniform reporting or monthly verified case lists (Effective 1-02-79).

headings.title: Certification for assignment upon jury trial demand
headings.reviewNote: Covers general requirement that municipal judge certify case for assignment when defendant demands jury trial.

headings.title: Municipal jury trial procedures in eligible populous cities
headings.reviewNote: Covers local jury trial procedures, appellate records, costs, and de novo waiver in eligible noncharter first-class county municipalities.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on certifying municipal jury trial demands for assignment and local municipal jury trial procedures for eligible populous noncharter first-class county cities.

headings.title: Municipal division report to supreme court clerk
headings.reviewNote: Covers presiding circuit judge report to the supreme court clerk by September 1, 2015, providing municipal division name, address, and requested standardized form information.

headings.title: Presiding judge notice upon division establishment or abolition
headings.reviewNote: Covers presiding judge notice to supreme court clerk and ninety-day report requirement upon establishing or abolishing municipal division.

headings.title: Supreme court conflict of interest rules
headings.reviewNote: Covers supreme court duty to adopt conflict of interest rules for prosecutors, defense attorneys, and judges with pending municipal division cases.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all three subsections on presiding judge reporting to the supreme court clerk by September 1, 2015, notice upon establishing/abolishing divisions, and conflict-of-interest rules; corrected subsection 1 title/note (not annual).

headings.title: Witness subpoenas, attachment, and witness fees
headings.reviewNote: Covers municipal judge duty to summon essential witnesses, enforce attendance by attachment, and tax witness fees as costs.

headings.title: Oral notice to present witnesses upon continuance
headings.reviewNote: Covers oral notice and docket entry as valid summons for present witnesses upon continuance of municipal trial.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on municipal judge witness summonses, attachment, witness fees, and oral docketed notice to present witnesses upon trial continuance (Effective 1-02-79).

headings.title: Procedure when offense is outside municipal jurisdiction
headings.reviewNote: Covers cessation of municipal proceedings and transfer to associate circuit judge when state criminal offense appears.

headings.title: Noncognizable status of repeat intoxication-related offenses
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that driving while intoxicated charges are not cognizable in municipal court if defendant has two or more prior offenses or contacts.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on stopping municipal trials when a noncognizable state criminal offense appears and barring municipal court cognizance of repeat intoxication-related traffic offenses (A.L. 2017 S.B. 34).

headings.title: Mandatory instruction and written central repository reporting policy
headings.reviewNote: Covers municipal judge instruction on intoxication laws, SATOP assessments, and written policy for timely highway patrol reporting.

headings.title: Submission of reporting policies to OSCA and highway patrol
headings.reviewNote: Covers submission of municipal disposition reporting policy to OSCA and highway patrol and OSCA model policy creation.

headings.title: Semiannual reporting of intoxication offense dispositions to circuit court
headings.reviewNote: Covers mandatory semiannual reports to circuit court en banc detailing adjudication, dismissal, or pending status of intoxication offenses.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all three subsections on municipal judge intoxication-law instruction, written central-repository reporting policies submitted to OSCA and highway patrol, and semiannual circuit court en banc reports; notes 2014 transfer from former section 577.006.

headings.title: Discretionary parole or probation and written certificate
headings.reviewNote: Covers judge authority to grant parole or probation upon guilty plea or conviction and requirement of written conditions certificate.

headings.title: Permissible probation conditions for restitution and community work
headings.reviewNote: Covers court authority to order victim restitution and performance of uncompensated public or charitable community service.

headings.title: Refusal of community work, supervisor immunity, and worker status
headings.reviewNote: Covers defendant right to refuse free work, qualified immunity for supervising entities, and non-employment status under chapter 288.

headings.title: Modification or enlargement of probation conditions
headings.reviewNote: Covers court authority to modify or enlarge conditions of probation prior to expiration or termination of probation term.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all four subsections on discretionary municipal parole/probation, restitution and free-work conditions, refusal/supervisor immunity/chapter 288 non-employment, and modification of conditions.

headings.title: Right to trial de novo from nonlawyer municipal judge
headings.reviewNote: Covers defendant right to trial de novo before circuit or associate circuit judge from judgment or guilty plea before nonlawyer judge.

headings.title: Trial de novo application timeframe and restrictions
headings.reviewNote: Covers ten-day trial de novo application from lawyer municipal or associate judge absent guilty plea or jury trial; source notes 1985 case annotation on jury trial right in circuit court.

headings.title: Jury trial on the record before associate circuit judge
headings.reviewNote: Covers requirement of record in jury trial before associate circuit judge and direct appeal on record to appellate court.

headings.title: Supreme court rules governing recording methods
headings.reviewNote: Covers supreme court rulemaking authority for record maintenance using stenographic, electronic, or mechanical recording.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all four subsections on trial de novo rights from nonlawyer and lawyer/associate judges, jury trial appeals on the record, and supreme court recording rules; notes 1985 en banc annotation on jury trial upon appeal.

headings.title: Request procedures upon absence, illness, or disqualification
headings.reviewNote: Covers procedures for requesting presiding circuit judge to designate special municipal judge upon judge absence or vacancy.

headings.title: Presiding judge appointment of special interim municipal judge
headings.reviewNote: Covers presiding circuit judge authority to appoint another municipal judge in the circuit as special interim municipal judge.

headings.title: Municipal ordinance compensation for designated judge
headings.reviewNote: Covers municipal governing body duty to provide by ordinance for compensation of designated interim municipal judges.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all three subsections on requesting a special municipal judge upon absence/illness/disqualification (including 6-month vacancy election rule), presiding judge interim appointment, and municipal ordinance compensation.

headings.title: Ordinance court costs, judicial education fund, and counsel fund
headings.reviewNote: Covers municipal court fees per case, indigent cost waiver, and one-dollar retention for judicial education and appointed counsel funds.

headings.title: Court costs for ordinance cases in associate circuit division
headings.reviewNote: Covers section 488.010–488.020 fees in associate circuit division ordinance cases, indigent waiver, ban on assessing costs against municipality upon acquittal/dismissal, and section 479.080(2) disbursement.

headings.title: Exemption of municipalities from associate circuit filing fees
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that a municipality filing cases before an associate circuit judge shall not be required to pay fees.

headings.title: Prohibition on judge, city attorney, or prosecutor fees as costs
headings.reviewNote: Covers prohibition on assessing fees for a judge, city attorney, or prosecutor as costs in a municipal ordinance violation case.

headings.title: Additional fee upon application for trial de novo
headings.reviewNote: Covers additional section 488.010–488.020 fee assessed in the manner of subsection 2 upon an application for trial de novo in municipal ordinance cases.

headings.title: Traffic violations bureau cost schedules for guilty pleas
headings.reviewNote: Covers municipal ordinance schedules of costs for guilty pleas processed in a traffic violations bureau, capped at subsection 1 or subsection 2 court costs.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all six subsections on municipal court fees, judicial education/appointed counsel funds, associate circuit division costs, municipal filing exemption, judge/prosecutor fee ban, trial de novo fees, and traffic bureau schedules; replaced all five mismatched draft headings/notes on subsections 2–6.

headings.title: Caps on fines and costs, confinement limits, and indigent waiver
headings.reviewNote: Covers fine caps for minor traffic and ordinance violations, confinement restrictions, indigent cost bans, and dismissal exemptions.

headings.title: Review and reduction of original fine and sentence after custody
headings.reviewNote: Covers court authority to review, reduce, or waive original fine and sentence for individuals held on show-cause orders or warrants.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on minor traffic and municipal ordinance fine/cost caps, confinement restrictions, indigent/dismissal cost bans, and post-custody review and reduction of fines or sentences (A.L. 2019 H.B. 192).

headings.title: Calculation of excess general revenue from municipal violations
headings.reviewNote: Covers annual percentage calculation of municipal violation revenue and remittance of excess over thirty percent to county school fund.

headings.title: Percentage threshold reductions to twenty and twelve and one-half percent
headings.reviewNote: Covers statutory reduction from 30% to 20% and 12.5% for charter counties over 950,000; 2017 source annotation notes City of Normandy v. Greitens held the 12.5% classification unconstitutional and severed it, leaving 20% statewide.

headings.title: Addendum to annual financial report filed with state auditor
headings.reviewNote: Covers mandatory certified addendum to state auditor report accounting for operating revenue, violation revenue, and percentage.

headings.title: State auditor rulemaking for addendum reporting procedures
headings.reviewNote: Covers state auditor duty to adopt rules for reporting addendum data allowing reasonable demonstration of compliance.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all four subsections on annual violation revenue percentage calculations, threshold reductions, certified state auditor addenda, and rulemaking; notes 2017 Missouri Supreme Court annotation (City of Normandy v. Greitens) severing the 12.5% special-law classification to leave a uniform 20% cap.

headings.title: Certification of substantial compliance with municipal court procedures
headings.reviewNote: Covers annual municipal judge certification of compliance with ten required procedures including prompt hearings, bail, and open courts.

headings.title: State auditor rulemaking for compliance certification
headings.reviewNote: Covers state auditor authority to establish rules and reasonable procedures for certifying substantial compliance.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on annual municipal judge certification of substantial compliance with ten enumerated court procedures and state auditor rulemaking.

headings.title: Sixty-day notice of addendum noncompliance by department of revenue
headings.reviewNote: Covers sixty-day notice of addendum failure or excess revenue discrepancy sent by department of revenue to municipality.

headings.title: Additional notice for unpaid excess revenue after late addendum
headings.reviewNote: Covers DOR review when a political subdivision files an addendum after notice and additional notice requiring payment of unpaid excess revenue within sixty days of the original notice.

headings.title: Petition for judicial review and disputed fund deposit
headings.reviewNote: Covers municipal petition for judicial review under section 536.150 and mandatory deposit of disputed funds into court registry.

headings.title: Circuit court determination and fund distribution
headings.reviewNote: Covers court authority to return improperly demanded funds to municipality and pay remaining funds to department for schools.

headings.title: Final notice, municipal docket certification, and revenue reassignment
headings.reviewNote: Covers final notice, five-day cure, immediate docket certification by presiding judge, diversion of collections to county schools, and reinstatement; source notes "sections" does not appear in original rolls.

headings.title: State auditor audit authority over submitted addenda
headings.reviewNote: Covers state auditor authority to audit municipal revenue addenda and supporting documentation.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all six subsections on DOR compliance review, 60-day notices, judicial review/registry deposit, circuit court fund return, final notice/docket certification, and state auditor audits; replaced mismatched subsection 2 heading/note and noted original-rolls footnote ("sections").

headings.title: Loss and withholding of general local sales tax revenue
headings.reviewNote: Covers forfeiture, DOR withholding, and school distribution of section 32.085 local sales tax revenues (excluding section 66.620 county trust fund) for addendum or excess-revenue noncompliance.

headings.title: Withholding of county sales tax trust fund distributions
headings.reviewNote: Covers forfeiture, county remittance, DOR withholding, and school distribution (including upon disincorporation) of sections 66.600 to 66.630 sales tax distributions for noncompliance.

headings.title: Disincorporation election procedures and ballot language
headings.reviewNote: Covers disincorporation election procedures, statutory ballot question, publication notice, and majority vote dissolution.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all three subsections on withholding general local sales tax, withholding section 66.600–66.630 county sales tax trust fund distributions, and disincorporation elections with embedded ballot table; fixed mismatched draft headings/notes on subsections 1 and 2.

headings.title: Establishment of traffic court in twenty-first judicial circuit
headings.reviewNote: Covers St. Louis County traffic court establishment, maximum three traffic judges, and judicial commission appointment process.

headings.title: Authority to hear nonfelony motor vehicle and ordinance offenses
headings.reviewNote: Covers traffic judge authority to act as commissioner for state nonfelony motor vehicle offenses and county or municipal violations.

headings.title: Limitation to two traffic judges upon county municipal court creation
headings.reviewNote: Covers traffic judge appointment cap of two judges upon creation of county municipal court and DOR review authority.

headings.title: Driver license review proceedings after January 1, 2002
headings.reviewNote: Covers post-January 1, 2002 local rule authority for traffic judges to handle call dockets, uncontested dispositions, and optional first-instance review under sections 302.535, 302.574, and 302.750.

headings.title: Division of circuit into geographical sectors
headings.reviewNote: Covers division of twenty-first circuit into geographical traffic court sectors established by court en banc.

headings.title: Traffic judge qualifications, residency, compensation, and restrictions
headings.reviewNote: Covers law license, St. Louis County residency, one-third salary compensation, outside practice bans, and non-state employee status.

headings.title: Operating procedures, evening and Saturday sessions, and jury certification
headings.reviewNote: Covers court operating rules, evening and weekend sessions, affirmative evidence inquiry, and jury trial certification.

headings.title: Telephone, written, and electronic plea procedures
headings.reviewNote: Covers operating procedures for entry of not guilty pleas and fine payments by phone, mail, or electronic transmission.

headings.title: Electronic recording and trial de novo remedy absent equipment
headings.reviewNote: Covers electronic recording requirements and right to trial de novo under chapter 512 if county fails to provide recording equipment.

headings.title: Limitation to two commissioner appointments
headings.reviewNote: Covers statutory restriction limiting circuit court to appointing two commissioners with designated traffic jurisdiction.

headings.title: County responsibility for establishment and operating costs
headings.reviewNote: Covers county funding obligation for all costs to establish and operate traffic court and county municipal court.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all eleven subsections on the twenty-first judicial circuit traffic court, commissioner jurisdiction, post-2002 driver-license reviews, sectors, judge qualifications/pay, evening/Saturday sessions, remote pleas, recording/trial de novo, two-commissioner cap, and county costs.
